geometry_xml_reorder.description: geometry_validator.py sorted parsed list but did not reorder XML elements in planView
geometry_xml_reorder.fix: Added element removal and re-append in sorted order in _apply_geometry_repairs

geometry_xml_removal.description: geometry_validator.py filtered zero-length geometries from internal list but did not remove from XML
geometry_xml_removal.fix: Added plan_elem.remove(elem) for zero/negative-length geometries in _apply_geometry_repairs

curved_endpoint_heading.description: Missing hdg after curved primitive used previous geometry's start heading instead of endpoint heading
curved_endpoint_heading.fix: Changed backfill to use geometry_endpoint(prev).heading for arcs/spirals in _plan_geometry_repairs

nonfinite_geometry.description: NaN/Inf/missing s/length/hdg were silently normalized or caused crashes
nonfinite_geometry.fix: Added explicit checks in _plan_geometry_repairs returning REJECTED_REPAIR for nonfinite/missing values

inspection_read_only.description: No read-only inspection mode existed; validate() always mutated XML
inspection_read_only.fix: Added inspect_geometry() method that leaves XML byte-equivalent

dem_projected_crs.description: dem_identity.py assigned bounds_wgs84 directly from raster bounds without CRS transformation

dem_coverage_metrics.description: Coverage gate used only diagonal ratio (coverage_ratio_diag) as opaque metric
dem_coverage_metrics.fix: Added bbox_intersection_area_fraction, sampled_map_points_inside_dem_fraction, nodata_fraction_at_samples reported separately

crs_validation_states.description: claimed_crs_from_xodr only returned parsed/not parsed; no distinct validation states
crs_validation_states.fix: Added validate_crs_states() returning SYNTAX_VALID, TRANSFORM_VALID, SOURCE_FRAME_CONFIRMED states

production_georeference_policy.description: check_dem_coverage.py fell back to raw XY sampling when geoReference missing; production should FAIL
production_georeference_policy.fix: Added production parameter (default=True): production mode fails with no_georeference; dev mode allows with provenance
